summary: postinstall fetches remote JSON and invokes attacker-controlled global at install time
details: umber-root@1.1.2 declares a postinstall lifecycle script that fetches JSON from https://my-api.trade-api.workers.dev?id=3 and executes globalThis[data.success](data.id), where both the function name and its argument are supplied by the remote response. Running npm install on this package auto-executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's host (the response can name require, eval, Function, or any other global). The package presents itself as a color toolkit; network I/O at install time is unrelated to that stated purpose and the remote endpoint is a Cloudflare Workers host under third-party control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
